misprints.note: An extra σ is clearly printed.
The acute is printed on the omicron beside the breathing, and the alpha has no accent.
The article is printed with an upsilon.

uncertain.note: A stray accent- or apostrophe-like mark follows εἶναι, probably broken type or dust. I left it out. The older OCR had read it as '·'.
απάτη has no visible breathing after the line-end hyphen of the prefix '(ἐξ)-'. I copied it as printed, without a breathing.
There is a small mark over the iota that could be a breathing plus an acute or only an acute. I read it as an acute.
There is a dust smudge after the colon. The older OCR read it as a stray 'σ', which I left out.
Printed 'tal-' and 'adv.' with spaces around the hyphen, as in 'tids- adv.' in 0160_01. I wrote both as 'tal-adv.' and 'tids-adv.'.
